senses.gloss: Fro,Ⓒadv.Ⓓ(In ‘to and f(ro)’) itastataH; ‘going to and f(ro)’ gamanAgamanaM.
Frog,Ⓒs.ⒹBekaH, darduraH, maMqUkaH, varzABUH, SA(sA)-lUraH, plavaH, plavagaH, plavaMgamaH, varzAGozaH; ‘she-f(rog)’ maMqUkI.

Frolic,Ⓒv. i.ⒹkrIq 1 U, vilas 1 P, vihf 1 P, Kel 1 P, ram 1 A, viBram 1, 4 P.
Ⓔs.Ⓓkeli f., vilAsaH, krIqA, vihAraH, vi-BramaH, lIlA, KelA, krIqAkOtukaM.
Ⓝ[Frolic]some,Ⓒa.Ⓓkeli-vilAsa-priya, vilAsin, krIqA-KelA-para, ullAsin, vihArin, kelikara; parihAsaSIla.

From,Ⓒprep.ⒹGen. ex. by abl., when denoting source or place.
Ⓑ
 2 (Of cause) by abl. or instr., (only by instr., the noun being f.); ‘f(rom) curiosity’ kutUhalAt-lena; ‘f(rom) its fragrance’ suraBitayA.
Ⓑ
 3 (Of persons) by abl., or sakASAt with gen.; rAmasya sakASAt ‘f(rom) Rāma’
Ⓑ
 4 (Of time) by A with abl. or in comp.; ‘f(rom) the beginning’ A-mUlAt; AjanmanaH, Ajanma; gen. by Ara-Bya or praBfti, with abl.; taddarSanAdAraBya or praBfti; ‘f(rom) this day’ adyapraBfti, adyArasya; ‘f(rom) above’ uparizwAt, UrDvAt ‘f(rom) day to day’ dinedine, dinAddinaM; ‘f(rom) below’ aDastAt, aDoBAgAt; aDaHsTAnAt; [] ‘f(rom) behind’ paScAdetya, pfzWataH, pfzWata Aga-tya; ‘f(rom) hence’ ataH, itaH; ‘f(rom) afar’ dUrataH, dUrAt; ‘f(rom) without’ bahirdeSAt; ‘f(rom) within’ aByaMtarAt, aMtaH pradeSAt.

Front,Ⓒs.ⒹagraM, agraBAgaH-deSaH, muKaM, mUrDan m.; ‘f(ront) door or gate’ muKaM, niHsaraRaM.
Ⓑ
 2 vada-naM, AsyaM, muKaM, AnanaM.
Ⓑ
 3 Siras n., lalAwaM; ‘in f(ront) of’ puraH, purataH, agre, agrataH, purastAt, pratyakzaM, samakzaM, sAkzAt, aBi-saM-muKaM-Ke, (with gen.); ‘f(ront) of war’ raRaDurA, raRa-Siras n., mUrDan m. n., ‘f(ront) of army’ senAmuKaM, senAgraM, agrAnIkaM (‘f(ront) ranks’); ‘in the f(ront)’ agre, mUrDni, Duri, Sirasi; ‘to place in the f(ront)’ puraskf, agraRIkf, agresarIkf.
Ⓔv.ⒹsaMmuKaM-Ke sTA 1 P or vft 1 A, saMmuKI-aBimuKI-BU; oft. by muKa or aBimuKa in comp.; ‘a house f(ront)ing the east’ prANmuKaM-prAcyaBimuKaM-gfhaM.
Ⓝ[Front]age,Ⓒs.Ⓓagra-pUrva-BAgaH, muKaM.
Ⓝ[Front]al,Ⓒa.ⒹlAlAwika (kI f.), lalAwa in comp.
Ⓔs.ⒹlalAwapawwaM; ‘f(rontal) of an elephant’ kuMBaH, gaMqaH.
Ⓝ[Front]less,Ⓒa.ⒹDfzwa, nirlajja, niztrapa.
Ⓝ[Front]let,Ⓒs.ⒹlalAwapawwaM.
Frontier,Ⓒs.ⒹsImA-man f., upAMta, paryaMtaH, prAMtaH, samaMtaH, sAmaMtaH-taM a.; ‘Dwelling on the f(rontier)’ sAmaMta (tI f.), sImAvartin, paryaMtasTa, prAMtanivAsin; See Border.
Frontispiece,Ⓒs.ⒹmuKapratimA-citraM; ‘f(rontispiece) of a house’ gfhamuKaM, gfhAgraBAgaH.

Frost,Ⓒs.ⒹtuzAraH, tuhinaM, himaM, avaSyAyaH, nIhAraH, prAleyaM, mihikA; ‘f(rost)-bitten’ himasikta, tuzAra-SIta-upahata.
Ⓝ[Frost]y,Ⓒa.Ⓓhima, tuzAra, hima-tuzAra-vat.

Froth,Ⓒs.ⒹPenaH-RaH, maMqaH-qaM, utsecanaM; See Ferment.
Ⓔv. i.ⒹPenAyate-maMqAyate (D.), utsic pass.
Ⓝ[Froth]y,Ⓒa.ⒹPenila, Penamaya (yI f.), Penin.
Ⓑ
 2 asAra, laGu, niHsAra, niHsattva^1, aMtaHSUnya.
[1] Correction submitted by on 20160822.

Froward,Ⓒa.Ⓓadamya, avineya, atilAlita, durlalita, ucCfMKala, durdAMta.
Ⓑ
 2 pratIpa, pratikUla, vakrasvaBAva, viloma, vAmaSIla, pratIpAcAra.
Ⓝ[Froward]ly,Ⓒadv.ⒹvakraBAvena, pratikUlaM.
Ⓝ[Froward]ness,Ⓒs.ⒹpratIpatA, vAmatA, vakraBAvaH, adamyatA.

Frown,Ⓒs.ⒹBrUBaMgaH, BrU(Bru)kuwi-wI f., BrUBedaH-kzepaH-saMkocaH.
Ⓔv. i.ⒹBrUkuwiM baMD 9 P or rac 10 or kf 8 U, BrUBaMgena dfS 1 P, BrUvO saMkuc 1 P; ‘Oh he just f(rown)s at myself’ aye mayyeva BrUkuwIDaraH saMvfttaH (U. 5).
Ⓝ[Frown]ing,Ⓒa.Ⓓnata-AkuMcita-BrU, saBrUBaMga.
Ⓝ[Frown]ingly,Ⓒadv.ⒹsaBrUBaMgaM, BrUkzepeRa, BrUkuwiM badDvA, saBrUkzepaM.
